reason: The pressure patch kit is the obvious way to seal the torn habitat wall.
expectation: The kit should seal the puncture, allowing the habitat to be refilled.

alternatives.reason: Stabilizing the lander is also necessary before retrieving supplies.

effect: The wall is sealed; the habitat still needs breathing gas.
reaction: The backing plate makes the repair feel physically plausible.
reason: The breathing-gas supply should refill the newly sealed habitat.
expectation: The sealed habitat will be refilled with breathing gas.

alternatives.reason: The lander also needs stabilizing before supplies can be retrieved.

effect: The habitat is breathable, and the next goal is to make the lander safe to board.
reaction: The regulator and gauge make the refill feel grounded.
reason: The shipping braces appear suited to supporting the unstable landing leg.
expectation: The braces should stabilize the lander for boarding.

effect: The braces first needed cutting into usable steel; the landing support still needs stabilizing.
reaction: The preparation makes sense, though I had expected the braces to fit directly.
reason: The prepared steel lengths and sheet may provide support beneath the unstable lander.
expectation: The steel will help stabilize the landing support, possibly with the tool kit.

effect: The steel became a load-spreading crib, making the lander safe to board and completing the chapter.
reaction: The wide base and inspection of critical parts made the repair feel grounded, though I had not expected the braces to need cutting first.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the cribbed landing platform was most worthwhile: the explanation connected the steel's shape and wide base to stabilizing the lander, while distinguishing a grounded repair from a permanent replacement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Refilling the habitat was straightforward and predictable, though the regulator and gauge provided useful physical detail.

surprise.text: The shipping braces could not be used directly; they first had to be cut into steel with the tool kit.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the need to prepare the braces was not obvious until the compatibility feedback revealed it.

continue.text: Yes. The practical repair details made me curious to see how the expedition develops, although this chapter's decisions were mostly straightforward.
